title: Visit Layers

hero.alt: Inside Layers, empty and quiet: globe pendants over a long counter and pale wood floors

pickup_note: Order ahead on Square and pick up at the front counter.

sections.heading: BART & bus
sections.text:
Downtown Berkeley BART is about a 15-minute walk (about ¾ mile).

AC Transit line 6 stops at Telegraph Ave & Haste St, about two minutes away. Lines 51B, 36, 22 and 27 stop on Durant Ave at Telegraph and at Dana, about three minutes away.

sections.heading: Parking
sections.text:
The city-owned Telegraph Channing Garage (2450 Durant Ave) is around the corner.

Metered street parking nearby takes coins, cards and the ParkMobile app.

sections.heading: Bike
sections.text: A Bay Wheels station sits at Haste St & Telegraph Ave, about two minutes away, and there are public bike racks along Telegraph.
